name: rad-writer
description: Draft, rewrite, edit, and proofread academic, creative, technical, business, email, social, and reference prose.

interface.shortDescription: Draft, rewrite, edit, and proofread clear prose.
interface.longDescription: Draft, rewrite, edit, and proofread prose for its reader, purpose, channel, and voice. Preserve facts, citations, meaning, and deliberate style.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this for clarity and reader fit.
Proofread this without changing its meaning or voice.
Review this draft and report issues without rewriting it.
Edit this technical guide for clear, direct instructions.
Tighten this email without adding claims.
Review this academic draft for unsupported claims.
Edit this scene without flattening its voice.
